{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for the presence of the six internal QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
print(df[df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99])

# Count how many such rows there are
print('\nNumber of QA orders with revenue = 999999.99:')
print((df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())"}
